# Index

Links that name the note with its extension:

- bare: [[Recipe.md]]
- heading: [[Recipe.md#Heading]]
- block: [[Recipe.md^block]]
- alias: [[Recipe.md|the recipe]]
- embed: ![[Recipe.md]]
- upper case: [[Recipe.MD]]
- folder: [[Papers/Draft.md]]
- folder with heading: [[Papers/Draft.md#Heading]]

And without it, which must stay without it: [[Recipe]]

Other notes whose names merely start the same way:

- [[Recipe.mdx]]
- [[Recipe.md.bak]]
- [[Recipe2]]
- [[Recipe2.md]]
